review_E_recorded_bounds: Added executable inputs have no dedicated control; detection is transitive through manifest changes (no file(GLOB)/aux_source_directory exists in this repository).

The derivation depends on the working tree's build/release-test/compile_commands.json, whose identity is not recorded; the counts/digests are reproducible on this host with this build tree, not portably.
A project source quoting a system header (e.g. #include "windows.h") would be reported unresolved because the INCLUDE environment path is not modelled; no such include exists in project source today.
